title: Understand the medical examiner or coroner's role
plain_summary: Medical examiners and coroners look into deaths that are sudden, unexpected, or unattended by a doctor. Their review can affect when your loved one is released to a funeral home and when the death certificate is finished.
why_now: Their review can decide when the funeral home can take the next step.

citations.authority_name: CDC Public Health Law Program, Death Investigation Systems
